selection.rule: next ten preserved baseline addresses after accepted Batch 002

decisions.contact_path: Packet 24 integration and acceptance execution becomes operational only after a candidate implementation exists and reaches the current truth, health, Safe Writer, or Code Safety surfaces.
decisions.rationale: Packet 24 being a runbook rather than executed proof does not itself fail a completed current RC capability. It is an active conditional risk tied to the planned candidate and acceptance chain.

decisions.contact_path: The complete candidate, guardian, promotion, rollback, monitoring, and proof pipeline becomes project-operational when the future safe-change chain is implemented.
decisions.rationale: Current tools provide bounded direct writing and local safety, not the complete candidate pipeline. The missing authorization is active conditional on the planned implementation phase.

decisions.contact_path: A repair and retest iteration loop is required when future candidates fail current truth scans, repair requests, runtime checks, guardian review, or promotion proof.
decisions.rationale: The current system can scan and prepare repair requests, but the missing candidate iteration packet becomes operational only when the future candidate workflow begins.

decisions.contact_path: Current repository changes, inventory evidence, Safe Writer commits, Code Safety records, and third-party runtime dependencies already require reproducible build inputs, locked dependencies, and artifact identity.
decisions.rationale: The project currently creates and changes runnable artifacts without a defined reproducible build and lock recipe. This is a current build-governance defect, not only a future pipeline concern.

decisions.contact_path: Safe Writer currently has direct GitHub write authority when the user supplies a token, while Code Safety is local and no protected branch or required review workflow governs implementation commits.
decisions.rationale: Repository writes are a current capability. The absence of CI, protected branch, and mandatory review controls directly affects current change safety and is a current defect.

decisions.contact_path: Current Notes and ZIP tools depend on JSZip, Safe Writer depends on the GitHub API, and trust-zone behavior depends on external platforms, yet no complete dependency, lock, SBOM, vulnerability, or license record exists.
decisions.rationale: Third-party dependencies are already present in active current capabilities. Missing supply-chain inventory and review are therefore a current defect.

decisions.contact_path: Sandbox, resource, and network-egress controls become operational when generated or candidate code is executed by the planned safe-change or backend path.
decisions.rationale: The current system has no autonomous candidate execution path. The missing containment controls are active conditional on future candidate execution.

decisions.contact_path: Task, candidate, approval, promotion, and rollback races become operational when the planned multi-stage safe-change workflow permits overlapping work or transactions.
decisions.rationale: Current work-thread and direct transaction surfaces exist, but the specified multi-stage concurrency hazard depends on the future candidate pipeline. It remains active conditional.

decisions.contact_path: Current truth maps, inventory manifests, source code, prompts and rules, schemas, safety records, and tool settings already change independently without one configuration-version identity.
decisions.rationale: Version and configuration drift already affects current route truth, inventory evidence, writes, and rollback records. The missing unified configuration management is a current defect.

decisions.contact_path: A disabled-by-default feature-flag lifecycle becomes operational when future modules, candidates, or promotion controls can be staged and activated.
decisions.rationale: The future modular implementation path is not yet active. The missing feature-flag lifecycle is therefore an active conditional risk rather than a failure of a completed current capability.

routing_fields_rule: All destination, law, watch-trigger, and semantic-cluster fields remain blank in this batch.
source_preservation_rule: All immutable source fields, addresses, source hashes, original wording, accepted Batch 001 and Batch 002 classifications, and total envelope count remain unchanged except for the ten selected applicability fields.
